title: Hafnium: Essential Vocabulary
name: Hafnium: Essential Vocabulary
description: The words you need to talk about Hafnium precisely.
key_points: Atomic number: The number of protons in an atom; defines the element.
Atomic mass: Average mass of an element's atoms, in atomic mass units.
Isotope: Atoms of the same element with different neutron counts.
Group: A vertical column of the periodic table; elements in a group share chemistry.
Period: A horizontal row of the periodic table.
Valence electrons: Outer-shell electrons that take part in bonding.
Electronegativity: How strongly an atom pulls bonding electrons toward itself.
Ionization energy: Energy needed to remove an electron from an atom.
Allotrope: Different structural forms of the same element, like diamond and graphite.
Half-life: Time for half of a radioactive sample to decay.
Ore: Rock from which a metal can be profitably extracted.
Alloy: A mixture of a metal with other elements to improve properties.

# Hafnium — self-test quiz demo
qa = [
    ("What is the chemical symbol for Hafnium?", "Hf"),
    ("Who discovered Hafnium?", "Dirk Coster / Georg von Hevesy"),
    ("What is symbol?", "Hf"),
    ("What is atomic number?", "72"),
    ("What is atomic mass?", "178.49 u"),
    ("What is group?", "4"),
    ("What is period?", "6"),
    ("What is category?", "transition metal"),
]
score = 0
for i, (q, a) in enumerate(qa, 1):
    print(f"Q{i}: {q}")
    ans = input("Your answer: ").strip().lower()
    if ans and ans in a.lower():
        print("Correct.")
        score += 1
    else:
        print(f"Answer: {a}")
print(f"Score: {score}/{len(qa)}")
